subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel create a new `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` plus hostname fallback contract, or should instance identity use standard OTel resource attributes or the canonical OpenClaw identity seam from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071?
rationale: The PR chooses an operator-facing env/default identity contract and a collector-visible host identifier; that is a product/API and privacy decision rather than a mechanical patch choice.

options.title: Align With Standard OTel Identity
options.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through standard resource attributes or the approved OpenClaw identity seam.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` only with explicit precedence, privacy expectations, docs, upgrade behavior, and real export proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Design
options.body: Keep this PR paused while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071 settles the durable resource-identity contract.

recommendation.title: Align With Standard OTel Identity
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through standard resource attributes or the approved OpenClaw identity seam.

likelyOwner.reason: bek91 owns and is assigned to the canonical diagnostics-otel resource-identity issue that this PR attempts to fix.
